notes: Instagram publishing must use the official Meta Instagram content publishing flow.
Live posting requires a connected Instagram professional account, valid permissions, user authorization, and explicit approval.
If media cannot be supplied through a supported official upload or hosted URL flow, HigherKey falls back to manual upload.
TikTok publishing must use the official TikTok Content Posting API.
Direct posting requires an approved app, valid scopes, user authorization, and explicit approval.
Unaudited clients may be restricted to private posting.

storage.notes: Token values must stay in local secure storage and must never be written to analytics, logs, source files, or committed config.
